text: The town gathers
Six players take their seats: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, and Terra. Nobody at the table knows who the killer is.

Sol claimed to be the officer on Day 2 and said they had checked Gemma as the killer, and Terra and Sonnet followed Sol's lead. Haiku's big mistake was going after Sonnet over a dodge on Day 1 instead of pressing Gemma's shifting reasons for attacking Haiku, which left Gemma free to run the table. The turning point came when Gemma would not name who killed Luna and kept doubting Sol instead of answering. Gemma was voted out on Day 2, confirmed she was the killer, and the town won with Sol, Sonnet, Terra, Luna, and Haiku still standing or having been cleared.
